title: Preserve and review the existing live deposit implementation
objective: Establish a safe starting point without discarding the current uncommitted work.
requirements: Review the live wallet, QR, explorer history, disabled bank/card, dependencies, README and tests already in the working tree.
Keep verified reID authentication and blue branding; separate these existing changes from future platform work.
acceptance: Current diff is reviewed and meaningful existing checks are recorded.
Baseline changes have a real GitHub commit before dependent implementation starts; no secrets are committed.

title: Approve platform scope and economic decision register
objective: Turn the confirmed requirements and remaining proposals into an explicit implementation specification.
requirements: Record INFRA-only settlement, two payment assets, 3.6 fixed rate, ERC-1155 ownership, sold-only rewards, unrestricted receiving/trading and v1 resale.
Resolve proposed zero fees, deposit-time allocation, no guaranteed buyback and fixed implementation versions; distinguish approved rules from proposals.
acceptance: Decision register has an owner and approval evidence for unresolved economic choices.
Frontend, contracts, backend and client wording use the same rules.

title: Verify the INFRA target network and asset manifest
objective: Establish authoritative network settings before deploying anything.
requirements: Use the confirmed current INFRA testnet/UAT target, chain 15324, and verify HTTPS RPC, explorer, native reAED, USDT address/decimals, gas, logs and finality behavior.
Verify ERC-1155 support and reID/MetaMask connectivity; never assume the separately approved production manifest equals testnet/UAT.
acceptance: Versioned manifest contains verified chain ID, RPC references, deployment blocks and asset metadata.
Read-only probes and network compatibility results are reproducible.

title: Specify integer pricing, ownership and sale accounting
objective: Make all economic calculations exact and reviewable.
requirements: Define fixed maximum N, total USDT atomic project value T, price T/N, exact divisibility and native conversion multiplier 3600000000000.
Specify whole-unit supply, no public burn/unrestricted mint, issued sold supply S, treasury proceeds and owner-held issued-token behavior.
acceptance: Examples cover minimum units, large values, rejection of non-divisible values and 10-of-1000 transfers.
Ownership h/N and allocation participation h/S are separately defined and labelled.

title: Specify reward allocation and rounding invariants
objective: Prove historical entitlements survive purchases, direct transfers and resale.
requirements: Define per-asset funded liabilities, claim tracking, transfer corrections and settling before balance changes.
Specify no-holder rejection, duplicates/references, rounding-reserve policy and the proposed allocation record time.
acceptance: Worked traces cover late buyers, repeated buys, partial/full exit, multiple deposits and two assets.
An invariant model states exactly who owns every funded unit and rounding remainder.

title: Specify application and contract permissions
objective: Separate staff authentication from wallet authority and unrestricted investor ownership.
requirements: Define staff RBAC, project-scoped assignments, wallet bindings, two-step changes and emergency capabilities.
No reID/KYC allowlist gates fraction transfers or contract trading; choose admin MFA and treasury signer policies.
acceptance: Permission matrix enumerates every privileged UI/API/contract operation.
Recovery, revocation and separation-of-duty cases are documented and approved.

title: Audit existing UI and Figma flows against live behavior
objective: Capture all minor UI requirements without preserving misleading demo behavior.
requirements: Inventory homepage, all 14 investor designs, responsive states, branding, icons, metadata, accessibility and wallet flows.
Record replacements for fabricated metrics, instant sellback, sample support/notifications and confusing claim versus withdrawal actions.
acceptance: Screen-to-feature coverage matrix maps every existing navigation target and major state.
Empty, loading, failure, indexing-delay and transaction-progress states are specified.

title: Approve API, event and lifecycle acceptance contracts
objective: Provide shared testable interfaces for independent repositories.
requirements: Specify transaction state machines, identifiers, event ordering, idempotency keys and canonical command inputs.
Define end-to-end scenarios and data provenance for every balance, price, reward and activity entry.
acceptance: OpenAPI/event schemas and acceptance scenarios are versioned.
No endpoint accepts unvalidated arbitrary calldata or browser-supplied identity authority.

title: Create and configure the five independent repositories
objective: Keep frontends, backend, contracts and indexer independently deployable.
requirements: Retain the existing investor repository and create separate admin, backend, contracts and indexer repositories.
Add repository instructions, protected branches, ownership, dependency lockfiles and no cross-repository relative imports.
acceptance: Each repository can be cloned, checked and built independently.
Repository registry records URLs and release responsibilities.

title: Publish versioned shared interface artifacts
objective: Synchronize contract ABIs, deployment manifests and API clients across repositories.
requirements: Generate contract ABI/type packages and OpenAPI clients from versioned releases.
Pin artifact versions and reject accidental network/address mismatches.
acceptance: Consumer builds use pinned artifacts rather than copied stale interfaces.
A compatibility check detects mismatched schemas and deployment manifests.

title: Set up independent CI and quality gates
objective: Require repeatable checks before merging or deploying.
requirements: Configure type checks, lint, relevant unit/integration tests, production builds and contract checks by repository.
Use protected CI credentials and dependency/secret scanning without logging secrets.
acceptance: A sample change runs required checks in each repository.
Release artifacts identify source commit and toolchain versions.

title: Define secure environment and credential provisioning
objective: Provision authorized development/testnet credentials and establish the private Notion register, runtime boundaries and production rotation gate.
requirements: Record actual project development/testnet credential values only in the dedicated private Notion Development Credentials page under the user's existing authorization; general documents, Services records and task bodies link to it without literal values.

Define per-environment variables, server-only reID/Pinata secrets, protected runtime injection, rotation ownership and sanitized examples; existing development/testnet credentials may be used for authorized development and must be rotated before live production.
Maintain the private Notion Services inventory as tools/services are added or changed, including purpose, environment, owner, hosting target, verified runtime status and credential-page reference.
acceptance: No literal credential appears in source, Git, local handoffs, general documents, task bodies, client PDF, generated clients, public frontend bundles or logs; the dedicated private Notion credential page is the authorized documentation exception.
Environment validation fails clearly on missing required values; production release checks require rotation without blocking current authorized testnet use.

The private credential register and Services inventory are linked from the project, with current values confined to the credential page and hosting targets distinguished from verified deployment state.

title: Scaffold the standalone backend service
objective: Provide the NestJS/TypeScript service and infrastructure foundation.
requirements: Configure PostgreSQL/Prisma, health checks, structured logs, validation, graceful shutdown and a Docker runtime targeting the FP server accessed through Teleport.
Add migration, local-development and API-versioning conventions; document the backend and PostgreSQL hosting target and actual runtime status in the private Notion Services inventory.
acceptance: Service starts independently with a clean database and passes health checks.
API rejects malformed requests and redacts confidential values.

title: Design and migrate authoritative off-chain data models
objective: Store private workflows and rebuildable chain projections with clear boundaries.
requirements: Model investors/connections, staff/roles/sessions, projects/revisions/media, intents, activity projections, support, notifications and audit records.
Use exact integer quantities and immutable chain-event identity; avoid treating projections as custody or settlement authority.
acceptance: Migration and rollback/recovery procedures run on an empty test database.
Constraints cover uniqueness, ownership scope, event deduplication and referential integrity.

title: Configure background jobs and retry policies
objective: Run durable non-interactive work outside frontend request lifetimes.
requirements: Set up Redis/BullMQ for reID status checks, notifications, media jobs and operational retries, targeting the FP server accessed through Teleport.
Use bounded retries, idempotency and dead-letter/manual-recovery handling; maintain separate Redis/worker entries and actual deployment status in the private Notion Services inventory.
acceptance: Restarting a worker does not duplicate a financial command or notification.
Failed jobs expose actionable status without leaking tokens.

title: Pin and scaffold the Solidity toolchain
objective: Start with an INFRA-compatible, reproducible contract toolchain.
requirements: Pin Solidity, EVM target, OpenZeppelin, Foundry and formatter/static-analysis settings after network probes.
Add deployment registry structure, test utilities and adversarial receiver/token fixtures.
acceptance: Local compilation and initial test suite run reproducibly.
INFRA compatibility evidence is attached before implementation deployment.

title: Implement the master project registry and factory
objective: Create and discover a distinct contract address for every project.
requirements: Implement createProject, getProject, isRegisteredProject and implementation-version reads with initialization validation.
Emit ProjectCreated including project ID, address, implementation and economic/metadata references.
acceptance: Only authorized creators publish registered projects and duplicate IDs are rejected.
Two projects have independent supply, funds and administration.

title: Implement fixed-version project deployment and initialization
objective: Deploy gas-efficient project contracts without silent upgrades.
requirements: Use ERC-1167 clones if the approved fixed-implementation model is retained.
Prevent uninitialized/duplicate initialization; version future implementations and validate all addresses.
acceptance: Unprivileged initialization and implementation substitution attempts fail.
New implementation versions do not alter existing project contracts.

title: Implement ERC-1155 ownership and fixed supply
objective: Represent whole transferable project fractions as token ID 1.
requirements: Expose ERC-1155 balance/transfer/approval/interface support and enforce immutable maximum supply.
Mint only from verified primary purchases; omit unrestricted mint and public burn.
acceptance: Buy 1000 and transfer 10 produces balances 990/10 with unchanged issued supply.
Invalid IDs, excess supply and malformed receivers revert correctly.

title: Implement exact quotes and economic getters
objective: Return canonical prices without floating-point or exchange-rate ambiguity.
requirements: Expose project value, maximum/issued/remaining supply, reAED and USDT prices and quotePurchase.
Use USDT atomic canonical price and exact 3.6 reAED conversion, with bounded quantity and stale-quote checks.
acceptance: Quotes match contract charges across boundary values.
Unsupported decimals and non-divisible project values cannot publish.

title: Implement primary-sale lifecycle and authorization
objective: Control when new fractions can be purchased.
requirements: Implement openSale, closeSale, sale state reads and role-restricted lifecycle changes.
Separate sale closure, archival and emergency suspension from ownership and historical claims.
acceptance: Purchases fail outside permitted sale state and remaining supply.
Sale events and authority transitions are complete and testable.

title: Implement native reAED purchases
objective: Collect native payment and mint fractions atomically.
requirements: Implement buyWithReAED with exact msg.value, quantity, recipient and expected-price validation.
Protect balance changes/revenue settlement hooks against reentrancy.
acceptance: Successful receipt includes correct mint and purchase event.
Underpayment, overpayment, stale quote and receiver failure revert payment and mint.

title: Implement verified USDT purchases
objective: Support direct USDT payment without implicit swaps.
requirements: Implement buyWithUSDT using verified address and SafeERC20; check actual received value.
Handle allowance flow explicitly; do not assume permit or fee-on-transfer support.
acceptance: Exact USDT payment mints the quoted quantity and updates proceeds.
Missing allowance, false-return token behavior and mismatched receipts cannot create ownership.

title: Implement isolated primary-sale proceeds
objective: Let authorized treasuries collect investment principal without touching rewards.
requirements: Track reAED/USDT sale proceeds independently from funded rewards and marketplace funds.
Implement withdrawSaleProceeds with recipient restrictions, liability checks and events.
acceptance: Unauthorized or excessive withdrawals revert.
Primary-sale withdrawals cannot reduce amounts owed to reward claimants.

title: Implement transfer-safe per-asset reward accounting
objective: Keep allocated rewards with the historical holder.
requirements: Implement cumulative allocation and balance-update corrections for mint, direct/batch transfer and resale.
Track per-wallet accrued/claimed amounts for both assets and protect historical reserves from late buyers.
acceptance: Late purchases and partial/full transfers preserve all prior-holder entitlements.
Independent reference-model traces and invariants match exact integer accounting.

title: Implement actual revenue deposits and references
objective: Allocate only real received revenue to eligible issued fractions.
requirements: Implement depositRevenueReAED and depositRevenueUSDT with authorized funders, sold-supply snapshot and unique references.
Reject no-holder allocation, duplicate references and unexpected token behavior; emit funding details and reporting references.
acceptance: A real deposit creates liabilities only for balances eligible under the approved record rule.
No database or yield edit can create claimable rewards.

title: Implement individual reward reads and claims
objective: Pay actual funded rewards in their original asset.
requirements: Implement claimable, claim and claimBoth with checks-effects-interactions and immutable recipient ownership.
Allow previous holders with zero current fractions to claim accrued rewards.
acceptance: Claimed amount cannot exceed wallet entitlement or pool funding.
Repeated claims, failed payouts and reentrancy do not double-pay or corrupt balances.

title: Implement bounded multi-project claims
objective: Let investors collect multiple project rewards safely.
requirements: Implement bounded claim batches using only factory-registered projects.
A routed claim always pays the entitled holder; specify partial-failure behavior.
acceptance: Batch size/gas bounds and mixed-success cases follow the approved API.
Caller cannot redirect another holder’s rewards.

title: Implement anchored metadata and manual yield revisions
objective: Publish presentation data without changing economic rights.
requirements: Implement versioned metadata URI updates/freezing and setIndicativeYield with period/effective date.
Emit auditable revision events; keep price/supply/reward allocation independent of yield.
acceptance: Yield changes alter display only and cannot mint or allocate money.
Frozen metadata and unauthorized updates are enforced.

title: Implement roles, two-step changes and scoped pauses
objective: Bound privileged operations and preserve investor rights during incidents.
requirements: Apply project/factory/marketplace roles, two-step owner/treasury changes and approved signer policy.
Scope purchase, listing, funding and emergency controls separately; explicitly decide any transfer/claim pause powers.
acceptance: Permission matrix is enforced by negative tests for every privileged function.
Revocation and recovery work without broad admin seizure/withdrawal capabilities.

title: Implement on-chain resale listing lifecycle
objective: Let holders offer a whole fraction quantity without custody escrow.
requirements: Implement createListing, getListing, cancelListing, expiry, chosen settlement asset and remaining quantity.
Validate registered project, unit price, seller, approvals and current balance; leave fractions with seller until fill.
acceptance: Seller retains ownership/revenue while a listing remains unfilled.
Expired, cancelled, unapproved and underfunded listings cannot fill.

title: Implement partial-fill quote and listing availability
objective: Give deterministic trade prices and available quantities.
requirements: Implement quoteFill with exact integer units and clear remaining-versus-available semantics.
Specify rate policy for resale price inputs and zero-fee proposal; validate deadline/expected amount protection.
acceptance: A 1000-fraction listing supports multiple bounded fills.
Competing fills and direct seller transfers cannot oversell.

title: Implement atomic reAED resale fills
objective: Settle native trades and transfer the correct fraction quantity together.
requirements: Implement fillWithReAED with exact payment, listing state update and ERC-1155 transfer.
Credit isolated seller proceeds and run transfer reward correction hooks.
acceptance: A failed token receipt reverts buyer payment, fill and proceeds accounting.
Partial-fill quantity and historical reward ownership remain correct.

title: Implement atomic USDT resale fills
objective: Settle approved USDT trades with the same ownership guarantees.
requirements: Implement fillWithUSDT with verified token/received-value checks and atomic fraction transfer.
Validate buyer allowances, asset choice, deadlines and expected cost.
acceptance: Successful trades collect exact USDT and credit the seller’s correct proceeds.
False/failed transfers and malicious callbacks cannot take fractions without payment.

title: Implement seller proceeds withdrawal
objective: Keep resale income independently withdrawable on-chain.
requirements: Expose proceeds by seller and asset and implement withdrawProceeds with authorized beneficiary.
Define failure/retry handling and emit proceeds withdrawal events.
acceptance: Seller can collect completed-sale proceeds once only.
No project owner, buyer or marketplace admin can withdraw another seller’s proceeds.

title: Finalize ABI, event coverage and deployed-address artifacts
objective: Make every important financial and administrative action observable.
requirements: Cover creation, purchases, transfers, sale states, revenue, claims, yield/metadata, listing/fill/proceeds and roles.
Publish generated ABIs, event schemas, deployment manifests and initialization arguments.
acceptance: Indexer consumers decode representative events without handwritten mismatched ABIs.
Artifacts include chain, implementation version, address and deployment block.

title: Complete contract unit and adversarial integration tests
objective: Validate successful and failed operations across all contract functions.
requirements: Cover authorization, initialization, ERC-1155 receivers, ERC-20 edge cases, native handling and event correctness.
Include purchase/transfer/resale/funding/claim/treasury sequences and every contract revert boundary.
acceptance: Pinned Foundry suite passes with documented coverage and gas reports.
Known failure scenarios prove atomic rollback and liability segregation.

title: Complete reference-model, fuzz and invariant testing
objective: Test economic safety over randomized sequences and precision boundaries.
requirements: Assert supply, no oversells, no historical reward leakage, no overclaim, funded conservation and proceeds isolation.
Compare multiple actors/assets, partial/full exits, concurrent ordering and rounding against an independent model.
acceptance: Long-run randomized suites pass with fixed reproducible seeds and failure traces.
Every invariant has an explicit specification and regression test.

title: Migrate real investor reID sessions to the standalone backend
objective: Preserve working login while removing business/auth persistence from the frontend.
requirements: Implement start/callback, PKCE/state, user mapping, logout, session expiry/revocation and safe frontend proxies.
Derive wallet/identity from verified reID responses; preserve exact registered callback origins.
acceptance: Login/logout and expired/invalid sessions pass integration tests.
No browser-supplied address can impersonate a connected investor.

title: Implement encrypted reID connection and transaction scopes
objective: Support actual wallet transaction approvals beyond read-only login.
requirements: Verify wallet:tx consent with provider; store access/refresh tokens encrypted server-side and rotate refresh tokens.
Handle expiry, reconnect, revoked grants and connection-specific scope checks.
acceptance: A consented UAT account can approve a harmless verified transaction intent.
Secrets never enter browser responses, URLs or logs; revoked connections fail safely.

title: Implement administrator username/password and MFA
objective: Authenticate staff independently from wallet connections.
requirements: Use Argon2id passwords, MFA for privileged roles, invites, recovery, suspension and session management.
Apply login throttles, secure cookies, CSRF protections where relevant and audit events.
acceptance: Valid staff login works and rejected/locked/expired/recovered cases are tested.
Connecting a wallet alone cannot create an admin session or role.

title: Implement staff roles, permissions and project assignments
objective: Enforce authorization at every privileged API boundary.
requirements: Implement role CRUD, permission assignment, staff invites/suspension and project-scoped memberships.
Mirror on-chain signing requirements without confusing database roles with contract authority.
acceptance: Each privileged endpoint has allow/deny tests for the permission matrix.
Scope escalation and self-promotion attempts are rejected and audited.

title: Implement authenticated admin wallet binding
objective: Link MetaMask/reID signers to authorized staff records.
requirements: Verify nonce/domain/chain-bound proof of wallet control and manage bindings/revocations.
Require an allowed signing wallet plus app permission for admin transaction commands.
acceptance: Replayed signatures and cross-user/cross-chain binding attempts fail.
Removed staff/bindings cannot prepare newly privileged actions.

title: Implement Pinata/IPFS upload and media validation
objective: Publish safe public assets through server-controlled upload flows.
requirements: Validate image/document size, type and metadata; use authorized server-only development/testnet Pinata credentials from protected runtime storage and rotate before live production.

Track CIDs, upload status, draft ownership and immutable published revisions; exclude private identity material and register Pinata as an external integration in the private Notion Services inventory.
acceptance: Uploaded project assets resolve and published metadata refers to exact CIDs.
Unauthorized uploads and unsafe/private asset exposure are prevented.

title: Implement project draft, review and publishing APIs
objective: Manage project creation without making the database the settlement authority.
requirements: Implement CRUD for drafts, economics validation, media/document associations, review and publish requests.
Track deployment receipts, metadata revisions, archive state and manual yield changes.
acceptance: A draft cannot appear as an investable on-chain project before confirmed publication.
Contract values and metadata revisions reconcile with published API records.

title: Implement canonical transaction command orchestration
objective: Prepare safe, idempotent transactions from typed business actions.
requirements: Support purchase, transfer, approvals, listing/fill/cancel, claims, proceeds, wallet sending and admin project/revenue commands.
Validate allowlisted chain/contract/function/asset inputs, simulate, estimate gas and enforce intent ownership/idempotency.
acceptance: Duplicate requests do not create duplicate executable actions.
Arbitrary calldata, wrong recipient, invalid wallet and unsupported network inputs fail before approval.

title: Implement approval, broadcast, receipt and confirmation tracking
objective: Display truthful transaction state through completion and indexing.
requirements: Handle Created, Awaiting approval, Broadcast, Confirmed and Indexed plus rejection/expiry/failure states.
Reconcile timeouts, provider retries and receipts after process restarts; never treat a hash as success.
acceptance: Rejected, reverted, delayed and successful UAT flows have correct recoverable states.
A confirmed action can be traced to receipt and indexed event evidence.

title: Implement actual portfolio and holdings APIs
objective: Replace simulated investment balances with on-chain projections.
requirements: Expose per-project ERC-1155 balances, h/N ownership, h/S participation, acquisitions and cost-basis records.
Separate actual transaction cost from indicative owner-entered valuations and show unknown values honestly.
acceptance: API holdings reconcile to chain reads for tested wallets.
No invented balance, return or guaranteed valuation appears in responses.

title: Implement revenue, claim and manual-yield APIs
objective: Expose funded income distinctly from presentation yield.
requirements: Return per-asset funding, allocation, claimable/claimed values and report/document references.
Prepare authorized revenue funding, yield changes and holder claims through canonical intents.
acceptance: Changing yield cannot change funded claimable values.
Per-wallet totals match contract reads and funding/claim events.

title: Implement marketplace listings, trades and proceeds APIs
objective: Provide browsable resale views without overriding contract truth.
requirements: Expose paginated/filterable listings, available quantities, expiry, approvals, fills, history and seller proceeds.
Prepare listing, cancel, fill, approval and withdrawal intents with fresh on-chain availability checks.
acceptance: Stale/offline projections cannot authorize an invalid trade.
Partial fills and revoked/insufficient balances produce correct UI-readable states.

title: Implement actual balances, wallet deposits and sending APIs
objective: Unify deposit ingestion and wallet operations for verified users.
requirements: Expose native/USDT balances, session-derived address/QR, real incoming/outgoing transactions and gas reserve checks.
Migrate the existing live deposit behavior; bank/card stay unavailable and refresh never credits invented money.
acceptance: Different signed-in users see only their own wallet views.
Amount precision, QR payload and chain provenance are verified; outgoing sends require wallet approval.

title: Implement user-scoped activity and reporting endpoints
objective: Make all confirmed financial history searchable and exportable.
requirements: Combine confirmed purchases, transfers, resale, proceeds, claims, deposits and wallet sends with typed filters/pagination.
Include transaction links, confirmation/indexing state, asset units and idempotent record identity.
acceptance: User scoping and pagination do not leak another account’s private activity context.
Records trace to chain receipts/events and exports retain exact amounts.

title: Implement persistent support tickets and replies
objective: Replace demo-only support interactions with durable service workflows.
requirements: Implement create/read/reply, staff assignment, status changes, resolution and reopening.
Validate attachments and investor/staff access boundaries with auditability.
acceptance: A ticket survives sessions and service restarts with complete conversation history.
Investors cannot read or modify another investor’s tickets.

title: Implement actual notifications and preferences
objective: Deliver actionable account/transaction events instead of sample alerts.
requirements: Generate purchase/fill/revenue/claim/approval/failure notifications from durable transitions/events.
Implement read/unread, pagination and preferences with idempotent delivery.
acceptance: Repeated jobs/event replay do not duplicate a notification.
Links open the actual related project or transaction; no fabricated earnings alerts remain.

title: Implement operational audit and monitoring APIs
objective: Make privileged actions, failures and recovery observable.
requirements: Record staff actions, role/wallet changes, metadata/publication and finance command references.
Expose health, indexer lag, reconciliation/backfill status and sanitized incident details.
acceptance: Authorized auditors can trace a privileged change to actor, time, command and chain evidence.
Audit entries are protected from ordinary edits/deletion and redact confidential values.

title: Publish and verify the complete REST/OpenAPI contract
objective: Give both frontends generated, stable and documented API clients.
requirements: Document authentication, all modules, validation, pagination, errors, idempotency and exact quantity serialization; archive API documents in the existing private Notion project.

Generate versioned clients and API contract tests; GraphQL remains optional and is added only for an approved concrete read requirement. If added, host it on FP accessed through Teleport and register it in Services.
acceptance: Both independent frontend builds consume pinned generated clients.
Schema tests catch incompatible API behavior and undocumented status responses.

title: Scaffold standalone INFRA ingestion and provider resilience
objective: Run a durable chain reader independently of frontend deployments.
requirements: Set up viem clients, verified manifests, health checks, Docker service and RPC fallback/rate limits, targeting the FP server accessed through Teleport.

Start from deployment blocks, use bounded log ranges and avoid reliance on an explorer-only recent page; maintain the indexer entry and actual deployment status in the private Notion Services inventory.
acceptance: Indexer starts independently and reads known deployed events.
Provider interruptions resume without losing or duplicating confirmed history.

title: Implement durable cursors and event identity
objective: Process every relevant event exactly once in projections.
requirements: Persist chain/address/block/log identifiers, block hashes and transactional checkpoints.
Make retries and backfills idempotent with deterministic within-block ordering.
acceptance: Reprocessing the same range leaves identical projections.
Crash/restart at a batch boundary neither skips nor duplicates an event.

title: Implement confirmation and reorganization recovery
objective: Prevent orphaned data from appearing permanently confirmed.
requirements: Apply verified INFRA finality policy and preserve recent block hash history.
Detect divergent blocks, roll back affected projections and replay the canonical range.
acceptance: A simulated reorganization removes orphaned events and restores correct balances/listings/rewards.
API can distinguish pending, confirmed and lagging index state.

title: Project registry, sale and metadata projections
objective: Discover factory-created projects and their current public data.
requirements: Index ProjectCreated, sale-state, supply economics, metadata/yield revisions and relevant roles.
Subscribe newly discovered project addresses from their creation block.
acceptance: Publishing a new project makes it discoverable with verified immutable economics.
Metadata/yield history preserves source block and transaction.

title: Index ownership, purchases and fraction transfers
objective: Build portfolios from canonical ERC-1155 events.
requirements: Handle TransferSingle/TransferBatch, mints, primary purchases and direct wallet transfers.
Keep h/N and h/S views consistent and distinguish purchase cost from transfer acquisition.
acceptance: Projected balances equal contract balances across mint/partial-transfer/resale fixtures.
Batch and repeated range processing preserve exact balances.

title: Index revenue funding, claims and indicative yield
objective: Expose actual funded and paid amounts by project, asset and wallet.
requirements: Project funding/claim records and allocation references; reconcile live claimable reads when needed.
Keep manual indicative yield separate from actual deposited/payout amounts and rounding reserves.
acceptance: Funding and claim reports reconcile to liabilities and transaction events.
Late buyers and exited holders retain correct historical views.

title: Index resale lifecycle, trades and proceeds
objective: Serve marketplace history with correct partial quantities.
requirements: Index listing/fill/cancel/expiry-derived status and seller proceeds/withdrawals.
Revalidate approvals and seller holdings for availability without changing on-chain listing truth.
acceptance: Partial-fill and revoked-approval fixtures produce truthful listing availability.
Seller proceeds match contract accounting and cannot be counted as project revenue.

title: Index direct native and USDT wallet activity
objective: Supply complete actual deposit and withdrawal history for connected wallets.
requirements: Implement verified native top-level/internal and USDT ingestion, exact destination/token validation and deduplication.
Define provider limitations/backfill coverage and distinguish wallet transfers from project commands.
acceptance: The existing known live deposit records reconcile without fabricated entries.
Failed, self, zero, outgoing and spoof-token transfers are handled per the approved activity rules.

title: Implement reconciliation, backfill and recovery controls
objective: Rebuild projections and detect silent accounting drift.
requirements: Schedule chain-versus-database supply/balance/revenue/listing checks and expose lag/failure metrics.
Provide authorized restart-safe backfill/replay operations and operational runbooks.
acceptance: Database projections can be rebuilt from deployment blocks with identical results.
Injected discrepancies and stalled ingestion trigger visible actionable alerts.

title: Build independent admin app shell and authenticated navigation
objective: Provide a branded, accessible admin application with its own FP-server deployment accessed through Teleport.
requirements: Use Next.js/TypeScript, generated API clients, shared approved visual assets and responsive navigation; target the FP server accessed through Teleport and record actual deployment status in Services.
Implement username/password, MFA, session expiry/recovery and route-level permission presentation.
acceptance: Staff can log in/out and reach only permitted screens.
App builds independently and does not include privileged API/provider credentials.

title: Build MetaMask and reID signer connection flows
objective: Connect an authorized wallet after staff authentication.
requirements: Support network validation/switch guidance, wallet proof binding, reconnect and disconnect/revocation.
Display app permissions separately from on-chain authority and require approval for privileged commands.
acceptance: Both approved providers can sign a verified UAT intent.
Wrong chain, wrong wallet and revoked binding block the action with useful feedback.

title: Build complete project draft and economic configuration wizard
objective: Let staff prepare accurate projects and fraction prices.
requirements: Capture owner/treasury, images, descriptions, required project data, total value, maximum fractions and public documents.
Preview exact reAED/USDT fraction prices and reject unsupported/non-divisible values.
acceptance: Draft save/resume preserves validated data and permissions.
Preview matches contract input and distinguishes ownership from revenue participation.

title: Build review, publish and contract lifecycle management
objective: Move a reviewed draft to a confirmed on-chain project.
requirements: Show content/economics review, signer requirements, simulation and deployment approval status.
Manage sale open/close, archive, contract/version/address and publication receipt history.
acceptance: A project appears publicly only after confirmed publication/indexing.
Failed or rejected deployment leaves a recoverable draft without duplicate projects.

title: Build project media, metadata and document revision management
objective: Manage public assets with traceable IPFS references.
requirements: Upload/preview validated files, inspect CIDs and publish controlled metadata revisions.
Expose freezing, effective revisions and audit history; separate drafts from published public records.
acceptance: Published metadata resolves to the correct assets and source transaction.
Unauthorized/frozen edits fail and do not silently change economic terms.

title: Build manual indicative yield controls
objective: Let project owners update labelled estimates without creating rewards.
requirements: Capture yield value, period, effective date and supporting report/reference.
Show revision history, signer requirements and explicit distinction from funded claimable revenue.
acceptance: Yield changes appear consistently on project views after confirmation.
No edit changes claimable balances or creates a revenue deposit.

title: Build revenue funding and primary treasury workflows
objective: Let authorized finance staff prepare and sign actual project funding and withdrawals.
requirements: Support asset/amount/reporting reference, no-holder checks, review, approval, receipt and retry handling.
Show isolated sale proceeds, funded liabilities, claims and finance-preparer/approver scope.
acceptance: Deposits allocate actual received funds and can be traced to receipts.
An unauthorized signer or attempted withdrawal of reward liabilities is blocked.

title: Build sales, holders, claims and marketplace reports
objective: Give operators and auditors accurate project oversight.
requirements: Display supply, wallet balances, funding/claims, listings/fills and seller proceeds with filters/exports.
Use exact units, source links, indexing freshness and clear indicative-value labels.
acceptance: Report totals reconcile to backend and contract samples.
Exports preserve precision and respect project/auditor permissions.

title: Build investor directory and staff/role management
objective: Manage staff authority without restricting public token ownership.
requirements: Provide staff invite/suspend, role/permission assignment, project assignments and wallet-binding review.
Show investor records and linked wallet context without exposing encrypted reID credentials or adding contract KYC gates.
acceptance: Authorized admins can manage roles with complete audit records.
Support/read-only staff cannot elevate privileges or access confidential auth material.

title: Build persistent support inbox and case workflow
objective: Allow staff to service actual investor requests.
requirements: Implement queue filters, assignment, replies, attachments, resolution and reopening.
Enforce scoped visibility and preserve conversation/audit history.
acceptance: A staff reply appears in the investor’s correct ticket after reload.
Unauthorized access and attachment leakage are prevented.

title: Build notifications, audit and chain-health operations views
objective: Expose actionable operational status and recovery controls.
requirements: Show real notifications, privileged action audits, indexer lag, reconciliation and backfill status.
Gate recovery commands and display source commit/deployment manifest versions.
acceptance: An injected indexer failure is visible with a permitted recovery path.
Read-only roles cannot execute operational mutations.

title: Verify complete admin workflows and accessibility
objective: Confirm administrators can operate the platform without unsafe hidden assumptions.
requirements: Cover draft/publish/update/fund/report/roles/support with both wallet providers and failure states.
Check responsive layout, keyboard/screen-reader behavior and confirmation/status language.
acceptance: Browser tests cover successful and rejected privileged actions.
No placeholder data or credential-bearing errors remain in admin production flows.

title: Integrate generated clients and real account/session state
objective: Replace the demo provider with actual identity and server-backed data.
requirements: Preserve working reID login and branding while moving authentication/business calls to approved backend boundaries.
Implement loading/empty/error/session-expiry states and remove demo-credit mutation paths.
acceptance: Existing signed-in users can reach the app with real wallet identity.
Production routes cannot synthesize balances or succeed from demo fallback state.

title: Replace homepage and explore projects with published data
objective: Show only actual published projects and truthful availability.
requirements: Load images/metadata, exact prices, remaining fractions and labelled owner-entered yield.
Keep original Fractionaire branding, blue UI, working footer links and responsive/scroll behavior from the approved UI.
acceptance: A newly confirmed project becomes discoverable and unpublished drafts remain hidden.
No fabricated live counters, sold percentages or price/yield claims remain.

title: Build complete live project details
objective: Explain economics, documents, ownership and revenue clearly.
requirements: Show total value, maximum/sold/remaining fractions, dual-asset prices, contract, metadata/documents and actual funding history.
Distinguish h/N project entitlement from h/S revenue participation and indicative yield from actual rewards.
acceptance: Displayed values match canonical quotes and project records.
Missing/failed data has explicit states rather than sample content.

title: Implement primary buy/rebuy flows in both assets
objective: Let investors purchase whole fractions with approved wallet transactions.
requirements: Support quantity selection, exact quote, balance/gas/allowance checks, USDT approval and reID confirmation.
Show approval/broadcast/confirmed/indexed states with rejection/expiry/revert recovery.
acceptance: Purchasing in reAED and USDT increases actual ERC-1155 holdings and charges exact amounts.
Repeat purchases retain historical rewards and no optimistic fake balance persists after failure.

title: Replace dashboard with actual portfolio and balances
objective: Provide a truthful account overview.
requirements: Show real holdings, balances, actual funded earnings/claims and recent activity with provenance/freshness.
Separate invested cost, manual/indicative valuations and realized proceeds; no guaranteed return calculations.
acceptance: Dashboard samples reconcile to contract/backend values.
Empty portfolios and indexing delays render clearly on desktop and phone.

title: Build holdings details and fraction transfer UI
objective: Allow arbitrary whole-quantity transfers to any valid INFRA wallet.
requirements: Show exact token balance and recipient/quantity review; warn through clear irreversible-action review rather than blocking unrestricted ownership.
Use reID approval and explain sender retains already allocated rewards while future allocations follow transferred units.
acceptance: Transfer 10 of 1000 confirms on-chain with balances 990 and 10.
Invalid recipients, insufficient balance and rejected approval cannot create a completed transfer.

title: Build actual earnings, funding history and reward claims
objective: Let current and former holders collect funded rewards.
requirements: Show claimable/claimed per asset, funding references and individual/bounded multi-project claims.
Keep manual indicative yield separate; allow claims after a full fraction exit.
acceptance: Historical-holder claim succeeds after transferring all fractions.
Failed/duplicate/rejected claims never increase displayed paid amounts.

title: Replace wallet balances and assets with INFRA reads
objective: Display actual native reAED, verified USDT and ownership tokens.
requirements: Use verified contract metadata and exact decimals; show connected wallet/chain and refresh timestamps.
Handle insufficient reAED gas, disconnected sessions and unavailable data explicitly.
acceptance: Wallet amounts reconcile to independent chain reads.
Unknown/spoof tokens are not presented as the platform’s verified USDT.

title: Complete live deposit migration and eliminate sample data
objective: Preserve the current real deposit behavior on the standalone backend/indexer.
requirements: Use session wallet, independently verified QR and real incoming activity; keep bank/card blurred, disabled and Coming soon.
Manual refresh checks chain data only; do not credit entered planned amounts or sample transactions.
acceptance: Two accounts receive their own correct QR/address/history and no query parameter can override identity.
Recent deposits show exact actual asset amounts, dates, explorer links and indexing/error states.

title: Implement real outgoing wallet transfers
objective: Send assets to another INFRA address with explicit wallet approval.
requirements: Support reAED/USDT, recipient validation, exact amount, gas reserve, fee review and receipt tracking.
Keep sending wallet funds distinct from selling fractions, collecting proceeds and claiming rewards.
acceptance: Approved sends reconcile to actual balance/history changes.
Max amount retains required native gas and failed sends never show as completed.

title: Build investor resale browsing and partial buying
objective: Make the v1 marketplace usable with real on-chain listings.
requirements: Show seller price/asset, available quantity, expiry and invalid/unavailable states.
Implement partial-fill quote, allowance/payment review, reID approval and transaction progress.
acceptance: A buyer purchases a partial quantity and receives actual fractions.
Stale, competing or revoked listings show recoverable failure without fabricated ownership.

title: Build listing creation, cancellation and seller proceeds UI
objective: Let investors resell held fractions and collect completed-sale proceeds.
requirements: Support ERC-1155 approval, quantity/price/asset/expiry, list/cancel and remaining-fill history.
Show seller keeps revenue while holding tokens and expose separate proceeds withdrawal; remove instant platform sellback.
acceptance: A 1000-fraction listing can fill in parts, cancel its remainder and collect exact proceeds.
Revocation/direct transfer/expiry states match contract availability.

title: Replace activity with actual filtered transaction history
objective: Explain all account actions with source evidence.
requirements: Show purchases, transfers, fills, proceeds, deposits, sends, funding allocations and claims with filters/pagination.
Use actual timestamps, asset quantities, chain links and distinct transaction states.
acceptance: Each completed item points to its real chain transaction or appropriate durable service record.
Reloading and event replay do not duplicate rows.

title: Implement durable investor support tickets
objective: Replace local/demo support with actual conversations.
requirements: Create/read/reply/reopen tickets and show staff response/status with controlled attachments.
Handle submission retry, validation and access denial.
acceptance: Tickets survive logout/reconnect and show the correct staff replies.
An investor cannot open another account’s support record.

title: Implement real investor notifications
objective: Show meaningful updates from account activity.
requirements: Replace fabricated notification rows with paginated actual events and read/unread actions.
Link approvals, failures, trades, claims and revenue updates to the relevant destination.
acceptance: Notifications update across reloads without duplicate delivery.
No sample earnings alerts remain in production.

title: Complete responsive, accessibility and data-provenance UI audit
objective: Finish all designed investor flows with honest states and consistent branding.
requirements: Audit the homepage and all 14 investor designs on desktop/phone, icons, logos, button radii, contrast, motion and reduced-motion behavior.
Remove every unsupported demo financial statement; cover skeleton, empty, stale, failure and reconnect states.
acceptance: Documented browser checks cover the complete investor journey with no overflow or broken images.
Each financial value is real, explicitly indicative or an honest unavailable state.

title: Complete cross-service threat model and security checks
objective: Review economic, identity, contract and operational attack paths.
requirements: Check signing commands, reID token handling, admin RBAC/MFA, uploads, rate limits, session/CSRF boundaries and secrets.
Run Slither/dependency checks and remediate critical/high findings with meaningful regression tests.
acceptance: Threat model links risks to controls and test evidence, with its document archived in the private Notion project.

No unresolved release-blocking finding remains; verify literal credentials are confined to the dedicated private Notion credential register and protected runtime storage, and require rotation before live production rather than as a blocker for authorized testnet work.

title: Complete backend/API/database integration suite
objective: Verify real service boundaries and failure recovery.
requirements: Test auth isolation, role restrictions, idempotent intents, token refresh, jobs, projections and private records.
Exercise delayed receipts, repeated callbacks, provider outages and database migrations.
acceptance: Suite runs against isolated services and passes in CI.
Tests prove no fake settlement, cross-user wallet override or silent data-loss fallback.

title: Run complete multi-wallet platform lifecycle tests
objective: Prove the intended business journey end to end.
requirements: Create/publish, buy both assets, rebuy, transfer 10 of 1000, partial resell, fund both assets, claim, fully exit and claim old rewards.
Cover admin preparation/approval, seller proceeds and history/notification/support propagation.
acceptance: Receipts, balances, allocations and projections reconcile for each step.
Browser/API/chain evidence records success and rejected/reverted variations.

title: Verify gas, throughput, pagination and operational bounds
objective: Keep production flows usable within INFRA and service limits.
requirements: Measure worst-case claim batches, event ranges, portfolios, marketplace reads and upload/report limits.
Test gas estimates, RPC rate limits, worker concurrency and large exact quantities.
acceptance: Published limits and latency/gas budgets have measured evidence.
No unbounded investor loop or single oversized request can block normal operations.

title: Complete independent contract review and release remediation
objective: Obtain a focused independent check before valuable deployments.
requirements: Review implementation against economics, reward correction/rounding, permissions and marketplace atomicity.
Fix findings and rerun affected tests; freeze reviewed release artifacts and compiler settings.
acceptance: Review report and remediation evidence identify the exact source commit.
No unresolved release-blocking accounting or authorization issue remains.

title: Implement reproducible deployment and verification scripts
objective: Deploy approved contracts without manual undocumented state.
requirements: Use authorized development/testnet deployer credentials from protected runtime storage and explicit network/role parameters; credential documentation values remain only in the dedicated private Notion Development Credentials page and must be rotated before live production.

Record addresses, source/compiler/version, constructor/initializer values, transaction hashes and deployment blocks; verify source when supported and archive deployment documents in the private Notion project without literal credentials.
acceptance: Dry-run and INFRA testnet/UAT deployment produce complete reproducible manifests.
Script rejects wrong chain, missing roles and stale artifacts; live-production release requires rotated credentials while current authorized testnet use is permitted.

title: Configure backend, indexer and database hosting
objective: Run durable platform services on the FP server accessed through Teleport, independently of the Vercel investor frontend.
requirements: Resolve the exact FP-to-Teleport-node mapping without guessing from inventory names; configure the FP server for the NestJS backend, private PostgreSQL, Redis/workers and standalone indexer, including container runtime, TLS/DNS, backups, migrations, scaling and protected environment injection.
Separate testnet/UAT and production environments; configure worker/indexer restarts and least-privilege service access. Optional GraphQL, only if separately approved, uses the same FP hosting target.

Maintain the private Notion Services inventory with purpose, environment, owner, hosting target, verified runtime/deployment state and credential-page reference; do not claim a planned service is deployed.
acceptance: FP-hosted backend, database, Redis/workers and indexer pass health checks and preserve data across controlled restarts; Teleport administrative access is verified.
Backup restore succeeds and no database/queue/admin endpoint is unintentionally public.
Service records distinguish FP hosting targets from observed deployment evidence and contain no literal credentials outside the dedicated private credential page.

title: Configure separate investor and admin frontend deployments
objective: Publish the investor frontend on Vercel and the admin frontend on FP with correct APIs, origins and callbacks.
requirements: Configure the investor frontend on Vercel and the independent admin frontend on the FP server accessed through Teleport, with HTTPS domains, server-only environment boundaries and registered reID callbacks.
Deploy pinned API/contract manifests; check cookies/CORS/redirects and admin isolation, and record each application's target, URL and verified runtime status in the private Notion Services inventory.
acceptance: Fresh browser sessions complete login and approved INFRA testnet/UAT actions at the investor Vercel URL and admin FP URL.
Public bundles contain no reID secret, Pinata credential or deployer key; private Services records accurately distinguish planned and deployed applications.

title: Configure alerts, monitoring and reconciliation operations
objective: Detect and recover from actual service/chain failures.
requirements: Monitor Vercel investor frontend and FP-hosted services for API errors, job failures, expired integrations, RPC availability, indexer lag, reorgs and accounting reconciliation.

Set alert ownership, dashboards, deploy-version visibility and incident escalation; archive operational documents in private Notion and update Services when monitoring tools/services are added or changed.
acceptance: A test outage/drift generates a useful alert and runbook-guided recovery.
Logs and alerts redact user credentials and private wallet authorization material.

title: Run client acceptance and deployment rehearsal on INFRA
objective: Get explicit sign-off on the complete working platform.
requirements: Rehearse the confirmed INFRA testnet/UAT environment, initial project setup, signer roles, revenue and resale with several wallets, using the Vercel investor frontend and FP-hosted admin/services once deployed.
Verify manual yield wording, h/N versus h/S, fixed rate, no guaranteed liquidity and bank/card availability with client; archive the acceptance/rehearsal documents in the private Notion project.
acceptance: Client acceptance checklist has linked evidence and resolved release blockers.
Final economic defaults, fees, allocation record rule and production network are explicitly approved.

title: Perform approved release and privileged-role handover
objective: Release only after explicit deployment authorization and completed gates.
requirements: Deploy/promote reviewed versions to their confirmed Vercel/FP targets, verify contracts/manifests and transfer roles to approved treasury/signers under explicit release authorization.

Confirm indexer start blocks, published initial data, smoke tests and emergency contacts; rotate development/testnet credentials before live production and record actual values only in the dedicated private Notion credential page.
acceptance: Deployment register links every repository release commit and contract transaction, is archived in private Notion, and matches verified Services runtime status.
Authorized operators verify privileges and investors can complete approved live flows; any live-production release uses rotated credentials.

title: Deliver operating runbooks, documentation and backlog evidence
objective: Make the platform maintainable across sessions and operators.
requirements: Document release/rollback limits, FP/Teleport operations, indexer recovery, production credential rotation, admin onboarding, finance funding and incident procedures; archive all project documents and revisions in the existing private Notion project.

Keep implementation plan and task statuses current; attach real GitHub commit URLs and verification before marking Done. Maintain Services continuously as tools/services are added or changed, including hosting target versus verified runtime status.

Keep actual development/testnet credential values only in the dedicated private Notion Development Credentials page under the user's existing authorization; link to that page from general documents and service records without copying literal values.
acceptance: A new Codex session can find repository roles, decisions, current state, archived project documents, current Services inventory, private credential-page reference and the next unblocked task.
Completed tasks link actual committed work; remaining tasks and known limits are explicit. No literal credentials appear in Git, local handoffs, client PDF, task bodies, logs or general documents.
